how to write faster
(APs + timed tests)

1. learn a few abbreviations

because, with, leads to:
make them symbols.
in a timed essay, every second counts.

2. write your thesis first

one sentence at the top.
then every paragraph just has to prove it.

3. use a paragraph formula

point, example, why it matters.
no blank-page panic.

4. practice past prompts with a timer

speed comes from doing it,
not from reading about it.

5. leave five minutes at the end

reread, fix the obvious mistakes.
it's worth more than one extra paragraph.
